subject: STABLE api-surface-sonnet #2: buffer-backed textures, foreign shared events, capability/identity queries; run_host_tests stanza
body: ASan+UBSan PASS gpu/tests/api_surface_frontend_test.py; texture_format_frontend_test PASS (release+ASan, same tree); iOS arm64 freestanding -Wall -Wextra -Werror compile clean. New: (1) -[MTLBuffer newTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow:] / newLinearTextureWithDescriptor:...: real buffer-backed 2D textures (no allocation, mip[0] at (offset,row), retained buffer) with -buffer/-bufferOffset/-bufferBytesPerRow; draw sampling it commits status 4; CPU round trip both ways; exact-fit and every refusal. Shared-file touch: render_encoder.inc ONE ivar line (bufferBackedOffset/Row/bufferBacked) + ONE view-copy line; compute_frontend.m the two TeguBuffer stubs now call tegu_buffer_make_texture. (2) foreign MTLSharedEvent objects (IOSurface-backed events created by frameworks) honoured via signaledValue/setSignaledValue:. (3) explicit NO for raster-order groups/32-bit filtering/BC/barycentric/dynamic libs/raytracing/function pointers/readWriteTextureSupport + productName/familyName/vendorName/sharedMemorySize/requiresIABEmulation (no longer left to the base class's unfilled _featureQueries). (4) tools/run_host_tests.sh runs api_surface_frontend_test after the IOSurface CPU test.
